module: Small text log of the career. Modules call addLog to accumulate lines in memory; on each profile save, the lines are appended (append mode) to the career.log file of the save slot, then the list is emptied.
notes: Line format: timestamp os.time()|severity|origin|message. Default severity "I", default origin empty string.
The in-memory list is emptied on career activation (onCareerActive): lines not saved before are lost.

addLog.desc: Adds a line to the in-memory log (written to career.log at the next save).

origin.desc: Name of the emitting module ("" by default).

severity.desc: Severity, "I" by default (the value is not validated).

onSaveCurrentProfile.desc: Hook called when the profile is saved: adds a "Save game to ..." line then writes (append) all the lines to <saveRoot>/<slot>/career.log and empties the list.

onCareerActive.desc: Hook called when career becomes active: empties the list and adds "Loaded game <path>".

active.desc: true on activation; nothing is done if false.
